vermilion_city.name: ARDOR CITY
vermilion_city.look: HEAT: roofs in hot glazed pantiles, the dock's planking sun-bleached, the cargo truck and planters redrawn, the harbour bollards as warm iron

moves.why: ARDOR's own row 11 was empty (every index magenta, no block draws it): now warm iron -- vanilla's greys at 1..7 warmed to iron, the truck's teal box (8, 9) to rust, the lamp's red band (12) and the truck's stripe (13) as they were
the harbour lights leave general's greys (rows 2/3, drawn on every map) for row 11
the truck on the quay leaves general's row 2 for row 11

lavender_town.name: HALFTONE TOWN
lavender_town.look: HALFTONE: every surface as a dot screen -- roofs, the boardwalks' planks, the KEEPALIVE PLANT's walls -- big dots on light, small on dark, so it reads as tone in grey and as dots up close

moves.why: the roofs' flat middle (702, vanilla's, all one index) is also the tower base's grey (row 9, ten blocks): the roofs get their own copy to dot, the tower keeps 702

celadon_city.name: VERDIGRIS CITY
celadon_city.look: VERDIGRIS: bronze roofs and trims furred with green bloom where the rain runs; ROUTE 17's cycling road as a long streak of smeared lanes (THE STREAK)

moves.why: the apartment blocks (row 12 is theirs alone): their flat roofs (general's grid, drawn here) from khaki to bronze gone green -- a verdigris patina, the grid's seams the deepest -- and the walls' pale mint a step deeper
the mansion's bloom (row 9, 9..11: the mansion's alone) to the same verdigris

saffron_city.name: BRAZEN CITY
saffron_city.look: BRASS: plating works -- roofs in stamped brass panels, walls in rolled sheet with rivet lines, the tower's glass in a gold curtain wall; the plaza laid in a corporate grid

moves.why: the green house roofs (general's ribbed roof, drawn in BRAZEN's row 11 at 10..14) in brass; 15 was free and keeps the old green for the two things that shared it (reindex below)
the PORT's green strip under its windows (777, 779, 782) and the dojo's weed (1013) keep the green (index 15) while their old indices turn brass
the tower's purple wings (row 8, 13/14: drawn by its wings and nothing else; the doors' purple is 7..9 and stays) in gold

fuchsia_city.name: LURID CITY
fuchsia_city.look: LURID: the SAFARI's woods and LURID's frontages in saturated glow -- neon trims, sickly bright foliage, signs that hum

moves.why: the SAFARI's canopy (row 11, 1..4: the SAFARI trees' leaves) from leaf green to a sickly acid glow -- chartreuse lit, a poison green body, the shade kept deep. The marsh teal (9, a, e) and the bark (6..8) stay

the pens' mint walls (row 9, a..e: their tops, faces and dark rims) as neon fuchsia -- LURID's own name for the colour, the tube lit pale, the face hot pink, the rims deep plum; the pens' fences and plaques (1..9) stay

cinnabar_island.name: QUICKSILVER IS.
cinnabar_island.look: MERCURY: the lab's walls as liquid-bright metal pooling at the base; the mansion's roof scorched; the shore's sand silvered

moves.why: the lab's cream walls (row 9, 1..5) as quicksilver -- a cold bright metal, white-lit, pooling dark at the foot
the MANSION's roof (row 8, 1..3) scorched: brick-brown to soot and ash; 4 (its lit edge) stays, since ROUTE 21's jetty draws it too
